question: How do people shaped by conceptual impressions worship the supreme Lord?
premises: Some worshippers approach the Lord wholly and others partially.
Their approach is shaped by streams of conceptual impressions.
These impressions arise from what they have heard in scripture.
inference: Therefore even conceptually conditioned worshippers can approach the all-pervading supreme Lord.
uncertainties: The compound vikalpaughasaṃskārādye is compact; the agent sense is inferred from context.
plain_english: Those whose minds are shaped by streams of conceptual impressions arising from scripture worship that all-pervading supreme Lord, either wholly or partially.
